errors.evidence: The description does not explicitly state that the chart shows the frequency of responses for the most important measures to limit the shadow economy, though it is inferable from the text.
The description does not mention that the chart is horizontal and that the vertical axis lists the measures while the horizontal axis shows percentages in the image/reference context.

The chart uses blue and red bars, but the description misstates the grouping as only two colors without noting that color maps to value ranges; however the more important issue is the subsequent incorrect assignment of several categories/values.
